summary: A free consultation offer, 18 languages and a one hour reply promise are strengths, but unfinished pages and a form that appears missing cost you enquiries.

findings.problem: The page says to use the yellow form below, but no form appears in the page text, and the only other options are email and phone with no WhatsApp.
findings.cost: Immigration clients decide fast and leave when the form is not there.
findings.fix: A working enquiry form with WhatsApp.

findings.problem: Several service pages appear to link to placeholder addresses such as /new-page-1, /new-page-20 and /new-page-83.
findings.cost: A client who clicks a service and finds nothing doubts the firm.
findings.fix: Real service pages that rank on Google.

findings.problem: The page shows no lawyer names, 'Happy clients can't be wrong' with no reviews, and the sentence 'Feel free to email us in' ends without a language before the list.
findings.cost: Clients hire a person, and proof and names are missing.
findings.fix: Named lawyers, real reviews and clean copy.

findings.problem: The full menu appears three times, the same team photo appears twice, and an empty cart icon is visible.
findings.cost: Template leftovers make a law firm look unfinished.
findings.fix: A clean, fast, mobile first layout.

redesign: Real service pages, named lawyers, reviews.
